notes.title: Version 1.0.70:
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.70:
New: Item [Red Envelope]; 【 Red Envelope 】 After use, randomly receive 88 (80%)/888 (15%)/8888 (4%)/88888 (1%) gold coins.
New: You can use 'Red Envelope'! Become a decorative object.
New: During the period of January to March in the game, there is a 60% chance of winning battles and receiving red envelopes.
New: During the period of January to March in the game, there is a 40% chance of discovering and dropping red envelopes.
New: During the period of January to March in the game, there is a 20% chance of losing a red envelope while fishing or catching.
New addition: [King's Island] Construction function adds a new ship [Chinese sailboat].
Add: Automatically receive 1 red envelope every 1-3 months after entering the game.
Fix: [Gear Clipper] There is an error when clicking to modify the pattern.
Wishing everyone a happy New Year 2025!!

notes.title: We participated in the Next Fest! A brand new demo is waiting for you !
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players, we are participating in the October New Product Festival! The demo has many new contents added, welcome to experience them! In the brand new demo, you can experience:
Freedom to pilot your ship and explore the endless ocean in search of hidden islands and treasures!
Trade between islands, acquire islands and build your own trade network!
Engage in fierce sea battles with pirates, defeat them and capture their loot!
In addition to this, we would also like you to add our game to your wish list, it would be very helpful and much appreciated!
Feel free to let us know if you have any questions as well.[/b]
